title: Open restriction of the counit-defined exceptional tensor map
statement:
Use the finite coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$, on the small pro-etale sites. Let $G:U^*\to V^*$ and $g:U\to V$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $u:U\hookrightarrow U^*$ and $v:V\hookrightarrow V^*$ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] with $Gu=vg$. Use the constructible adjunctions and exceptional composition of [def-trf-admissibility]. Identify $u^!$ with $u^*$ and $v^!$ with $v^*$ as right adjoints of extension by zero, using the open adjunctions $u_!\dashv u^*$, $v_!\dashv v^*$ of [prop-exc-open-adjoint], and write
$$\kappa_M:u^*G^!M\xrightarrow{\sim}g^!v^*M,\qquad \lambda_N:u^*G^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}g^*v^*N$$
for the resulting exceptional and ordinary composition isomorphisms. For any such morphism $h$, define $T_h:h^!M\otimes h^*N\to h^!(M\otimes N)$ as the exceptional adjunct of
$$Rh_!(h^!M\otimes h^*N)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_h^{-1}}Rh_!h^!M\otimes N\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_h^!\otimes1}M\otimes N,$$
using the normalized projection map of [def-exchange-projection], invertible on these domains by [prop-functor-package](5). For $M,N\in D^b_{ctf}(V^*,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the identity
$$\kappa_{M\otimes N}\circ u^*T_G(M,N)=T_g(v^*M,v^*N)\circ(\kappa_M\otimes\lambda_N)$$
holds after the canonical pullback--tensor identifications. No Cartesian hypothesis on the open square and no properness hypothesis on $g$ or $G$ is imposed.
